senses.gloss:
The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'nature or action thereof' after a stem ending in इक् (इ ई उ ऊ ऋ or ऌ) when the preceding syllable is prosodially light.

Terms: अण्

In a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) the first member preserves its original accent before a stem ending in a simple vowel with the exception of अ (इक्) before a word denoting time, as well as before 1. कपाल 2. भगाल and 3. शराव।

Terms: द्विगु समास
